description: This course gives hands-on training to the undergraduate students for various experiments related to production technology such as MIG/TIG welding, Wire EDM, CNC turning/milling, Tool Life equation, Rotary USM etc. Students will learn to use the equipment and perform practicals on the same.
experiments: To perform different operations of CNC turning center and measure the force and vibration during machining
To perform machining (square shape) on CNC-wire cut EDM machine and study the effect of electrical parameters on Cutting speed
Study and experiment on Robotic Pulse MIG welding cell
Study and experiment on robotic pulse TIG Welding Cell
To perform milling operation on CNC Vertical milling Center and measure cutting force during milling
To perform drilling operation on Rotary Ultrasonic Machining Set up
Gear cutting by milling and hobbing processes
Testing the sand properties- mould hardness and grain size
Study and experiment on tool life in turning operation
